notes: See what Lupo needs: A new Permissions… window in the menu bar lists Screen Recording, the microphone and the speech model, says which are missing, and has a button that fixes each one. The tour now starts with it.

Know what a starting session is waiting for: Instead of "Preparing…", Lupo says whether it's waiting for the microphone prompt or downloading the speech model, and how far along it is. On a Personal Hotspot, where that download can stall, it says so. You can cancel, or type your notes instead.
The tour no longer hides macOS's permission prompts: Prompts could open underneath the tour's dimmed screen and leave Lupo unresponsive.

releases.notesMarkdown:
## Improved
- **A clearer update window** Updates now open in Lupo's own window, with each change given a short title and grouped by what's new, improved or fixed.

notes: When Lupo leaves the prompt on your clipboard for you to paste, it now says so clearly ("Copied. Paste with ⌘V") and tells you where to paste it.
New Paste for Me button: one click and Lupo pastes the prompt into your current chat from then on. You still press Return to send.
Messages after Done stay on screen longer, so you have time to read them.
Right after an update, Lupo now shows what changed.
